$schema.description: Editor hint only; ignored by the loader.

id.description: Profile id creatures refer to, e.g. "humanoid".

notes.description: Why these values (tuning band, canon, intended users), for owner review.

nearRange.description: Metres within which a visible target is noticed at the full detection rate.

farRange.description: Metres beyond which it sees nothing; detection falls off from near.

primaryHalfAngle.description: Half-angle of the focused (primary) cone, degrees from the facing direction.

peripheralHalfAngle.description: Half-angle of the peripheral cone, degrees; at least primaryHalfAngle.

verticalHalfAngle.description: Vertical half-angle above and below eye level, degrees.

darkVision.description: How well it sees in darkness, 0–1: 0 = needs light, 1 = unaffected.

detectionSpeed.description: Multiplier on how quickly sightings build awareness; 1 = baseline.

thresholdDb.description: Quietest sound it hears, dB at the listener after propagation.

range.description: Metres beyond which it hears nothing, however loud.

smell.description: Smell; absent = no sense of smell.

range.description: Metres it can smell a scent source in still air.

windSensitive.description: Whether wind carries scent to it (downwind smells farther).

tracksScentTrails.description: Whether it follows scent trails left by moving targets (hook; post-MVP simulation).

special.description: Special senses by channel (tremor, life-sense, magic-sense); absent = none.

minStrength.description: Weakest signal it registers, 0–1 (after range falloff).

requiresLineOfSight.description: Whether walls block it (false = senses through walls and floors).

requiresMovement.description: Whether it only senses targets that are moving.
